capabilities: Convert .daylio backup archives into one note per entry with mood, activities and HTML converted to Markdown
Preview entry counts, missing photos, unsupported media and file conflicts before import
Copy referenced photos into an attachments folder and add image embeds to notes
Merge imported entries as list lines with block IDs into daily notes (Pro)
Filter entries by date range and set file name rules with tokens (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a vault backup tool; it only converts Daylio backup files into notes and photos inside the vault.
extras: Freemium: merging into daily notes, date filters and saved rules require a paid GitHub Sponsors sponsorship; sign-in uses the GitHub device flow and makes no network requests until used. The plugin opens a promotional 'What's new' tab after updates that suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). Only schema 15 Android backups were supported and tested with a synthetic backup; iOS backups, real backups, HEIC display and mobile use are untested. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Daylio backup archives into notes, so mood-tracking journal data stays locked in the Daylio app.

relations.evidence: Convert a local Daylio backup from Android into journal notes.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: One-way importer that converts Android Daylio .daylio backup files (schema 15) into journal notes with moods, activities and photos.
